messages:
alex_csm: Heads up — QBR for Atlas next Tue 10am PT. Need to finalize: onboarding status slide, renewal risk heatmap, and two concise exec asks. Draft deck: https://drive.google.com/xyz. Who can own numbers + narrative?

maria_success: I can take onboarding status & CSAT. Will update churn/activation metrics on `Slide 5`.

sam_sales: I’ll own renewal risk and the pricing ask. Thinking of two-tier ask: 1) extend at current T&Cs, 2) pilot migration to Dedicated w/commit. Need ARR numbers.

jamie_product: Quick flag — roadmap commitment we reference on slide 7 isn’t locked. Can we reword to "planned" not "committed"? Don’t want execs promising feature dates. :warning:

alex_csm: Good call @jamie_product — change to "planned". @maria_success + @sam_sales please sync on the customer migration timeline so messaging aligns.

maria_success: Agreed. I have onboarding blockers list (3 items). Will include risk-level per item and owner. Also adding CSAT trend sparkline.

sam_sales: Sharing ARR + renewal cadence now: 
```
- ACV: $420k
- Renewal window: June 2026
- Upsell target: $120k
```

alex_csm: Nice. For exec asks we should be explicit and short: 1) Approve 12-month Dedicated pilot w/ 20% discount cap, 2) Exec sponsor intro for platform migration. Anything else?

jamie_product: Suggest add a fallback: if migration not approved, we propose performance SLA uplift on hosted plan (low-effort commitment).

maria_success: Slide checklist I’ll follow: 
```
- Slide 3: TL;DR account health (green/yellow/red)
- Slide 4: Onboarding status + actions
- Slide 5: Metrics (activation, CSAT, usage)
- Slide 6: Renewal risk & mitigation
- Slide 7: Exec asks (2 bullets)
```

ops-bot: Reminder: QBR deck must be in `Customer QBRs/Atlas/` 24h before presentation. Deadline: 1865348400 (human-readable: Mon 10am PT).

alex_csm: Thanks all. Quick runbook: please drop final slides by Mon 9am PT. I'll compile and do dry-run Mon 3pm PT. Final action items below — ping me if you hit a blocker. :thumbsup:

Action items (from thread):
- maria_success: update Slide 3-5 + onboarding blockers & CSAT sparkline (due Mon 9am PT)
- sam_sales: populate renewal risk slide with ARR numbers and propose pricing ask text (due Mon 9am PT)
- jamie_product: update roadmap language to "planned" and add fallback SLA option (due Mon 9am PT)
- alex_csm: compile deck, lead dry-run Mon 3pm PT, prepare exec one-pager (due Mon 2pm PT)
- ops-bot: verify deck placed in GDrive path and send reminder Mon 9:05am PT

If anything changes ping thread. I'd like to keep exec asks under 30 words each.
